records.source: Hey, kid. The name's Pam.#$e#Don't be a jerk and we'll get along fine.
records.translation: 嘿，小鬼。我叫潘姆。#$e#別當個混蛋，我們就能相處得很好。

records.source: Well I'll be darned... I never expected to get a gift like this. You made my day, kid!
records.translation: 我的老天……從沒想過自己會收到這種禮物。小鬼，你讓我今天心情大好！

records.source: Looks like there's some unique fish swimmin' around. Next time I'll have to bring my pole!
records.translation: 附近好像有些稀奇的魚在游。下次我得帶上釣竿！

records.source: Heh... Willy gave us each a piece of his fish jerky on the ride over. Delicious!
records.translation: 嘿……來的路上，威利給了我們每人一塊他的魚肉乾。真好吃！

records.source: I'll really miss that girl...$s#$b#You treat my Penny good, now. You hear me?$u
records.translation: 我會非常想念那個丫頭……$s#$b#你現在可得好好對待我的潘妮。聽見了嗎？$u

records.source: So, you married the Mullner boy, huh?#$b#Will you be takin' that smelly old dog with ya, too?
records.translation: 所以，你和穆爾納家的小子結婚了，嗯？#$b#你也會把那條臭烘烘的老狗帶走嗎？

records.source: It's a sign from the Almighty... We're doomed...%noturn$s
records.translation: 這是全能者降下的徵兆……我們完蛋了……%noturn$s

records.source: Well, I guess the end-times haven't come just yet, kid...#$e#Ah well, back to the ol' nine to five...
records.translation: 好吧，看來末日還沒到，小鬼……#$e#唉，該回去繼續朝九晚五的老日子了……

records.source: I think these rains are a show of force... a warning.#$b#You could say it's from nature, from Yoba, whatever you like... but that's what I think.#$e#What I mean is, we can't get too cocky. Or else, instead of a green rain, maybe we'll have a blood-red rain... See what I mean?
records.translation: 我覺得這些雨是在展示力量……是一種警告。#$b#你可以說它來自大自然、來自尤巴，隨你怎麼說……但我就是這麼想。#$e#我的意思是，我們不能太自大。否則下次來的也許不是綠雨，而是血紅色的雨……懂我的意思嗎？

records.source: Penny came home crying... what'd you do to her?$3
records.translation: 潘妮哭著回家……你對她做了什麼？$3

records.source: Heard you got a fish pond built... Heh, I grew up with a fish pond.#$b#You can raise just about anything in one of those... But some of the fancier fish are real fussy!
records.translation: 聽說你蓋了一座魚塘……嘿，我從小就在魚塘旁長大。#$b#那裡幾乎什麼都能養……不過某些名貴的魚可挑剔得很！

records.source: Alright, alright... you beat me fair and square at the fishing event, kid.#$e#Hmm... maybe my problem was using that beer-battered mushroom as bait...$u
records.translation: 好啦，好啦……你在釣魚比賽堂堂正正地打敗了我，小鬼。#$e#嗯……也許問題出在我拿啤酒麵糊蘑菇當魚餌……$u

records.source: Now this is comfort! I might even take my shoes off!$h#$e#Better not look too closely at my feet, kid.
records.translation: 這才叫舒服！我甚至想把鞋子脫掉！$h#$e#小鬼，你最好別太仔細看我的腳。

records.source: It's a special occasion, kid... I'm ordering something unique. Make it a double!$h
records.translation: 今天是特殊場合，小鬼……我要點些特別的。來雙份！$h

records.source: Wow, would you look at that... It's like something out of the future.#$b#Hehe, sorry kid... I can't use that. There's more buttons than I have brain cells!$h
records.translation: 哇，瞧瞧那東西……簡直像來自未來。#$b#嘿嘿，抱歉啦，小鬼……我用不了。上面的按鈕比我的腦細胞還多！$h

records.source: I can't believe you bought me a house! Is there any catch?#$e#Sorry, I'm not used to people being so nice...$s
records.translation: 真不敢相信你送了我一棟房子！有什麼條件嗎？#$e#抱歉，我不習慣別人對我這麼好……$s

records.source: I'm loving the new house. Thanks again, kid!$h
records.translation: 我很喜歡新房子。再謝你一次，小鬼！$h

records.source: I can't believe someone bought me a house! I wonder if it's some kind of scam?#$e#Sorry, I'm not used to people being so nice...$s
records.translation: 真不敢相信有人送了我一棟房子！不知道這是不是某種騙局？#$e#抱歉，我不習慣別人對我這麼好……$s

records.source: Date night with ol' Pam, huh? Hah!$h^Ladies night with ol' Pam, huh? Hah!$h#$b#Sure thing, kid... I'll see you there.
records.translation: 和老潘姆約會的夜晚，嗯？哈！$h^和老潘姆共度女士之夜，嗯？哈！$h#$b#當然可以，小鬼……到時見。

records.source: Hey, did you hear about the ol' bus?#$b#Yep... I'm back on the saddle, kid... hehe. Feels nice.$h
records.translation: 嘿，你聽說那輛老公車的事了嗎？#$b#沒錯……我又重操舊業了，小鬼……嘿嘿。感覺真好。$h

records.source: #$1 PamDrank#Urghh... my head...$k#$e#You know, I'd eat healthier food if I could afford it.#$e#Hey, you probably have a lot of tasty grub growin' on your farm, hm?
records.translation: #$1 PamDrank#呃……我的頭……$k#$e#你知道，要是負擔得起，我也會吃得更健康。#$e#嘿，你的農場大概種了不少好吃的東西，嗯？

records.source: Nothin' like a sip o' the good stuff to warm these old bones...$h
records.translation: 沒有什麼比啜飲一口好酒更能溫暖這把老骨頭……$h

records.source: Ah... Finally./I need a drink./Gus! Gimme the usual./Hey, I'm back!/Ooh boy, am I thirsty!/I'm parched!
records.translation: 啊……終於到了。/我得喝一杯。/格斯！給我老樣子。/嘿，我回來了！/喔，老天，我渴死了！/我口乾舌燥！

records.source: Penny! Did you make dinner?/Penny! You done your chores?/Penny! You home?/Hey! I'm home!
records.translation: 潘妮！你做晚餐了嗎？/潘妮！家事做完了嗎？/潘妮！你在家嗎？/嘿！我回來了！

records.source: Hey, kid. I'd buy you a drink if I could afford it!
records.translation: 嘿，小鬼。要是我付得起，就請你喝一杯！

records.source: Hey Gus! Gimme another round! *hic*$h
records.translation: 嘿，格斯！再給我來一輪！*嗝*$h

records.source: *Sigh*... Hey, kid. You're too young to be moping around in a place like this.
records.translation: *嘆氣*……嘿，小鬼。你還太年輕，不該在這種地方愁眉苦臉。

records.source: *gulp* ... I've been looking forward to this beverage all afternoon. Heh heh.
records.translation: *大口喝下*……我整個下午都在盼著這杯飲料。嘿嘿。

records.source: Oi, Gus! Gimme another pint of your strongest!
records.translation: 喂，格斯！再給我一品脫最烈的！

records.source: %Pam isn't responding.
records.translation: %Pam沒有回應。

records.source: %Pam seems out of it. Better leave her alone right now.
records.translation: %Pam似乎神智不清。現在最好別打擾她。

records.source: Hey, you! Don't be snoopin' around the trailer when I'm out. Got it?$u#$e#Sorry, but I gotta be cautious with strangers.
records.translation: 嘿，你！我不在時別在拖車附近鬼鬼祟祟。懂了嗎？$u#$e#抱歉，但我得提防陌生人。

records.source: I was reading the newspaper this morning but then I got depressed. It's a rotten world, kid.#$e#Keep your head screwed on right and you'll make it through in one piece...#$b#That's what my Pappy always used to say. Heh heh heh.$h
records.translation: 我今天早上看報紙，結果心情變得很糟。這世界爛透了，小鬼。#$e#保持頭腦清醒，就能完完整整地撐過去……#$b#我老爸以前總是這麼說。嘿嘿嘿。$h

records.source: $d bus#You don't know how glad I am that the bus is up and running! I feel alive again.|Times have been tough lately. I got laid off of my job as a bus driver. If I got that job back I could drive you to Calico Desert.
records.translation: $d bus#你不知道公車重新運行讓我有多高興！我又覺得自己活過來了。|最近日子很不好過。我的公車司機工作被裁掉了。要是能拿回那份工作，我就能載你去卡利科沙漠。

records.source: #$1 PamDrunk#Blahh... I had one too many caramel porters at the saloon last night... Go away.$k#$e#My house ain't pretty but at least it's by the river.#$e#Hey. Penny's my baby girl. Be nice to her or leave her alone, got it?
records.translation: #$1 PamDrunk#呃……我昨晚在酒館多喝了一杯焦糖波特啤酒……走開。$k#$e#我的房子不好看，但至少就在河邊。#$e#嘿，潘妮是我的寶貝女兒。好好對她，不然就離她遠點，懂嗎？

records.source: Penny says I spend too much time at the saloon...$s
records.translation: 潘妮說我在酒館待的時間太長……$s

records.source: It's awful lonely at home all by myself...
records.translation: 獨自待在家裡實在寂寞得要命……

records.source: You know, I've been thinking... I wish I had a hobby. Something to do other than hanging around at that saloon every night.#$e#You got any ideas?#$e#...Ehh. Maybe I'll play checkers against myself.
records.translation: 你知道嗎，我一直在想……真希望自己有個嗜好。某種能讓我不必每晚泡在酒館裡的事情。#$e#你有什麼主意嗎？#$e#……呃。也許我可以自己跟自己下西洋棋。

records.source: Each day's just the same as the last...$s#$b#If only I'd been born rich...$s
records.translation: 每天都和前一天一模一樣……$s#$b#要是我生來有錢就好了……$s

records.source: Make sure your boots are clean before you go stompin' around in my house.$u#$e#It's annoying to clean a mess. You should know that by now.
records.translation: 在我家裡到處踩之前，先確定你的靴子乾淨。$u#$e#收拾髒亂很煩人。你現在應該知道了。

records.source: I wish a team of elves would come during the night and tidy up my house. Hahahaha.$h#$e#I could sure go for some parsnips.#$e#If my legs weren't so stiff I'd visit the mountains every now and then.
records.translation: 真希望有一隊精靈會在夜裡來替我整理房子。哈哈哈哈。$h#$e#我真想吃點防風草。#$e#要是雙腿沒這麼僵硬，我偶爾也會去山裡走走。

records.source: Are you friends with Gus? He's a pretty good guy.#$e#He even gives me free beer on my birthday.
records.translation: 你和格斯是朋友嗎？他人挺不錯。#$e#他甚至會在我生日那天送我免費啤酒。

records.source: Hey, watch your mouth! No one tells me what to do!$u
records.translation: 嘿，說話小心點！沒人能命令我做事！$u

records.source: ...it isn't? That's terrible!$s#$b#...Oh.$s
records.translation: ……不是嗎？太糟了！$s#$b#……喔。$s

records.source: Hi, stranger.
records.translation: 嗨，陌生人。

records.source: Oh, it's Mr. @.^Oh it's Miss @.#$e#Do you need my help or something?
records.translation: 喔，是@先生。^喔，是@小姐。#$e#你需要我幫忙之類的嗎？

records.source: I had hopes and dreams like you, once... But look at me now.$s#$e#Life doesn't always turn out like you expect.#$e#Ah well. There's no sense dwellin' on what you don't have.
records.translation: 我曾經也像你一樣懷抱希望和夢想……但看看現在的我。$s#$e#人生不一定會照你的期待發展。#$e#唉，算了。老想著自己沒有的東西毫無意義。

records.source: Havin' a local farm is good for our town.
records.translation: 本地有座農場，對我們的小鎮是好事。

records.source: Maybe if you do real well on your farm it'll boost the local economy.#$e#Then everyone will have a job and we'll all be happy, right?
records.translation: 也許只要你好好經營農場，就能帶動本地經濟。#$e#到時人人都有工作，大家都會開心，對吧？

records.source: Oh, hi there, farmer.#$e#I don't often chit-chat with strangers.
records.translation: 喔，你好啊，農夫。#$e#我不常和陌生人閒聊。

records.source: I always seem to end up at the saloon at some point.#$e#It's too close to my house. It ain't healthy.
records.translation: 我好像總會在某個時刻走進酒館。#$e#它離我家太近了。這樣不健康。

records.source: ...Yeah?#$e#You're a fine lookin' young man. Why're you wastin' your time talkin' to an old girl like me?^You're a pretty gal. What're you wastin' your time talkin' to someone like me for?
records.translation: ……幹嘛？#$e#你是個挺英俊的年輕人。為什麼浪費時間和我這種老姑娘說話？^你是個漂亮姑娘。幹嘛浪費時間和我這種人說話？

records.source: Don't mind that ol' dog next to the house.#$b#He might look at you cross, but he'll never get up from that box in a hunderd years.#$b#The old boy's name? It's Dusty.
records.translation: 別在意屋旁那條老狗。#$b#牠也許會不爽地瞪你，但一百年都不會從那個箱子裡站起來。#$b#那老傢伙叫什麼？牠叫達斯迪。

records.source: Someone's been complainin' about my yard... sayin' it's a mess. Was it you?$u#$e#Hmmm...
records.translation: 有人一直抱怨我的院子……說那裡亂七八糟。是你嗎？$u#$e#嗯……

records.source: If I knew you better, I'd be more inclined to chat.
records.translation: 要是更瞭解你，我大概會更願意聊天。

records.source: I used to be young, once. Hard to believe, huh?#$e#Time sure goes fast when you grow up.$s
records.translation: 我也曾經年輕過。很難相信，對吧？#$e#長大以後，時間真的過得很快。$s

records.source: *Sigh*... I guess I'll be popping a frozen dinner into the microwave tonight.$s
records.translation: *嘆氣*……看來今晚又得把冷凍晚餐丟進微波爐了。$s

records.source: Penny's the only one I've got, so you best treat her kindly.
records.translation: 潘妮是我唯一的親人，所以你最好善待她。

records.source: Every day is the same old routine...$s#$e#Do you ever have that problem, farmer?
records.translation: 每天都是一成不變的老一套……$s#$e#你也有這種問題嗎，農夫？

records.source: Would you do me a kindness and clean up my house?#$e#Just kidding.$h
records.translation: 能不能好心替我打掃房子？#$e#開玩笑的。$h

records.source: Don't you have work to do?#$e#You should be thankful that you have a job rather than moping around town all the time.
records.translation: 你沒有工作要做嗎？#$e#你應該慶幸自己有份工作，別整天在鎮上愁眉苦臉。

records.source: I miss my old truck driving job. I used to go all around the valley, meetin' people, listenin' to the radio.#$e#Times sure do change.
records.translation: 我懷念以前開卡車的工作。那時我會跑遍山谷、和人們見面、聽收音機。#$e#時代真的變了。

records.source: You got any hogs on that farm?
records.translation: 你的農場有養豬嗎？

records.source: Do you want somethin' from me, kid? Best look somewhere else.
records.translation: 你想從我這裡得到什麼嗎，小鬼？最好去別處找。

records.source: I just hope Penny has a good life ahead of her. If you ever have kids you'll know how I feel.#$e#...It's so dry in winter. My skin feels like old parchment.
records.translation: 我只希望潘妮今後能過上好日子。等你有了孩子，就會明白我的感受。#$e#……冬天真乾燥。我的皮膚摸起來像老羊皮紙。

records.source: Hey. You better be treatin' Penny right on that old farm of yours. She's the only one I got!
records.translation: 嘿。你最好在那座老農場好好對待潘妮。她是我唯一的親人！

records.source: Hey kid. What're you up to?#$e#I'm just passin' time, same as always.
records.translation: 嘿，小鬼。你在忙什麼？#$e#我只是在打發時間，和往常一樣。

records.source: It's awful cold. A visit to the saloon should warm me up, don't you think? Heh heh.#$e#Why don't you swing by the saloon later for a taste o' the Oh-Be-Joyful?
records.translation: 天氣冷得要命。去一趟酒館應該能讓我暖起來，你不覺得嗎？嘿嘿。#$e#你晚點何不來酒館，嚐嚐「樂翻天」？

records.source: Penny sure does like old books. I think she's a heck of a lot smarter than I ever was.#$e#I'm glad.
records.translation: 潘妮真的很喜歡舊書。我覺得她比我過去聰明太多了。#$e#這讓我很高興。

records.source: I oughta take up fishin', seein' as how close the river is.
records.translation: 河就這麼近，我應該開始學釣魚。

records.source: Blah... my front yard's a mess.$s
records.translation: 呃……我的前院亂七八糟。$s
